entries.name: Input Prompts
entries.modifications: Selected vector glyphs combined into one SVG sprite sheet (symbols); fill colour driven by CSS currentColor. Shapes unchanged.

entries.name: Universal Base Characters (Standard)
entries.modifications: Base body + one rigged hairstyle merged into one skinned glTF per character (player, affected). The suit albedo is desaturated/darkened and overlaid with a cloth-weave noise so it reads as plain dark street clothing (the Standard pack ships no outfit meshes; see PLACEHOLDER_ART in the ledger). Textures resized to 1024² (precached) and 2048² (desktop stream), KTX2. Skeleton unchanged.

entries.name: Universal Animation Library (Standard)
entries.modifications: Only the clips the state machine uses are kept (idle, walk, jog, sprint, pistol idle/aim/shoot/reload, hit, death, interact, roll, torch idle); the mannequin mesh is stripped. Non root-motion variant.

entries.name: Universal Animation Library 2 (Standard)
entries.modifications: Only the affected-resident clips are kept (Zombie_Idle_Loop, Zombie_Walk_Fwd_Loop, Zombie_Scratch, Hit_Knockback, Melee_Hook); mesh stripped. Non root-motion variant.

entries.name: Aarfontein Dusk (HDRI)
entries.modifications: Downsampled to 512×256 (precached, mobile) and 1024×512 (desktop stream) RGBE; exposure unchanged. Used for image-based lighting only.
